newsitem.title: USA: Cali to buy Mack, Patriot assets in $1.2 billion deal.
newsitem.headline: Cali to buy Mack, Patriot assets in $1.2 billion deal.

text.p: Cali Realty Corp. said on Thursday it agreed to buy the office assets of the Mack Co. and Patriot American Office Group, both private real estate concerns, in a $1.2 billion transaction.
The deal will create one of the country's largest real-estate investment trusts, with a total market capitalization of $3.3 billion, Cali said.
The company will operate under the name Mack-Cali Realty Corp.
The transaction will add 55 office properties totaling about 9.5 million square feet in the Northeast and Southwest to Cali's portfolio, for a combined portfolio of 185 properties in 10 states.
The Mack Co.'s properties are located primarily in New Jersey and Arizona. The properties of Patriot American Office Group are located primarily in Texas and Arizona.
Cali's stock gained $1.25 to $37 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Cali's president and chief executive, Thomas Rizk, will remain chief executive of Mack-Cali Realty Corp.
"This merger represents an historic opportunity for Cali and its shareholders," Rizk said in a statement.
"It truly solidifies our position as the dominant super-regional REIT in the Northeast, plus it provides us with new strategic beachheads in the Southwest for future growth opportunities," he said.

William Mack will serve as a director and chairman of the executive committee and Mitchell Hersh, partner and chief operating officer of the Mack Co., will serve as president and chief operating officer of Mack-Cali.
The terms of the agreement call for Cali to pay $476 million in cash and assume $302 million of mortgage debt.

Cali also will issue 3.9 million common operating units in Cali Realty, L.P. and issue $250 million of preferred operating units in Cali Realty, L.P., paying a 6.75 percent distribution and convertible into 7.2 million common operating units.
In addition, Cali will issue warrants to purchase two million shares of its stock at $37.80.
As part of the deal, the Mack Co, a New Jersey-based private real estate concern, will contribute its 5.9 million square-foot class A office portfolio and related operations.
Patriot American Office Group, a Dallas-based private real estate concern, will contribute its 3.6 million square-foot portfolio and related operations.
